prompt: Which equation represents the incomplete combustion of methane?
markscheme: **B.** Limited oxygen gives carbon monoxide and water; the equation is balanced.

prompt:
Ethanol can be produced from sugar cane and used as a fuel.

**(a)** Write the equation for the fermentation of glucose. **[1]**

**(b)** Write the equation for the complete combustion of ethanol. **[1]**

**(c)** Discuss whether bioethanol can be described as carbon-neutral. **[3]**
markscheme:
**(a)** $\text{C}_6\text{H}_{12}\text{O}_6 \rightarrow 2\text{C}_2\text{H}_5\text{OH} + 2\text{CO}_2$ ✓

**(b)** $\text{C}_2\text{H}_5\text{OH} + 3\text{O}_2 \rightarrow 2\text{CO}_2 + 3\text{H}_2\text{O}$ ✓

**(c)** CO₂ released on combustion (and fermentation) was recently absorbed by photosynthesis ✓; so in principle no net increase ✓; but energy for farming, fertiliser production, distillation and transport usually comes from fossil fuels, so it is not fully carbon-neutral ✓
